positive youth development (PYD) is the developmental process that is the outcome of positive experiences in positive environments, which in turn are the result of the positive actions of positive people.
PYD is the process of developing the potential of youth to be healthy, competent, and productive members of their families, schools, communities, and societies.

we are interested in the processes that foster healthy and positive youth development, and we are interested in understanding how to promote positive development in young people.
